_comment: Per-reel look. A reel's `style` field picks any of these; omitted parts rotate by reel number (theme n%10, layout n%3, backdrop (n+1)%4, type floor(n/2)%2, motion (n+1)%3), so the full combination repeats only every 60 reels. Audio is Qur'an recitation (see scripts/sources/recitation.mjs), not part of the style. Read by src/brand/theme.tsx, scripts/style.mjs and scripts/synth-audio.py.
